action_items.task: Take last dose of apixaban Monday night, October 5; no doses Tuesday through Friday morning; restart only as directed by the doctor after the procedure.
Stop fish oil starting Friday, October 2.
Have a light low-fiber breakfast before 9 a.m. Thursday, October 8; clear liquids only after that.
Start first half of the prep at 6 p.m. Thursday, October 8.
Start second half of the prep at 1:45 a.m. Friday, October 9 and finish by 2:45 a.m.; nothing by mouth after 4:45 a.m. except the lisinopril sip.
Take 20 units insulin glargine Thursday night instead of 40 units.
Skip metformin Friday morning.
Take lisinopril Friday morning with a small sip of water.
Check blood sugar when waking Friday and before leaving; bring the meter.
Call if fever is 100.4 or higher, the cough worsens, or shortness of breath develops before Friday.
Call the after-hours number if vomiting prevents keeping the prep down.
Arrive at 6:45 a.m. Friday, October 9; check in at the second-floor endoscopy suite; park at Entrance B off Wellstone Avenue and bring the ticket for validation.
Bring ID, insurance card, medication list, reading glasses, warm clothing, and meter; leave the partial denture at home if possible; no jewelry except the wedding ring may be taped.
Stay in the waiting area or be reachable and return within 15 minutes; come in to get the patient; sign the driver attestation form.
Tell the patient when to restart apixaban after the procedure depending on findings.
Monitor the Halvard authorization status.
Note the umbilical hernia for the doctor.
Email the prep calendar and driver attestation form to wof58@mailbridge.com.
Send a text reminder with arrival time and address to 555-0124.
Attend follow-up with Dr. Lindqvist-Amaro on Thursday, October 22 at 1:15 p.m.; Loretta may attend.
Call at least 48 hours ahead if rescheduling.
